title: Tiny, cute red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <!-- car body main -->
  <rect x='10' y='48' width='80' height='26' rx='10' fill='#e83a3a'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge -->
  <rect x='12' y='48' width='76' height='8' rx='8' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- cabin/roof -->
  <path d='M28 48 L36 30 Q38 26 44 26 L62 26 Q68 26 70 30 L78 48 Z' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <!-- windshield left -->
  <path d='M34 46 L40 32 Q42 29 46 29 L48 29 L48 46 Z' fill='#9ee8ff'/>
  <!-- windshield right -->
  <path d='M52 29 L56 29 Q60 29 62 32 L68 46 L52 46 Z' fill='#9ee8ff'/>
  <!-- headlight left -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='62' r='4' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <!-- headlight right -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='62' r='4' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='10' y='68' width='80' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c42b2b'/>
  <!-- left wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='9' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='5' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='73' r='2' fill='#c4c4d4'/>
  <!-- right wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='73' r='9' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='73' r='5' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='73' r='2' fill='#c4c4d4'/>
  <!-- window divider -->
  <rect x='49' y='29' width='2' height='17' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <!-- door line -->
  <rect x='47' y='50' width='2' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c42b2b'/>
  <!-- side mirror left -->
  <rect x='26' y='46' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- side mirror right -->
  <rect x='69' y='46' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- cute smile on front -->
  <path d='M40 58 Q50 64 60 58' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
